title: SDK helpers: pagination, batching, and resilient streaming for vectors + reranking endpoints
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Goal: provide a consistent, ergonomic set of SDK helpers across Python, TypeScript, and Go that make it straightforward to page and batch requests to vector (embeddings) and reranking endpoints, while offering uniform retry/backoff semantics and optional streaming ergonomics for large result sets. This ticket covers design, cross-language API surface decisions, reference examples, and companion tests/benchmarks. Motivation: customers are building large vector search + reranking flows and keep reimplementing pagination/batching + retry logic. We should ship canonical helpers to reduce mistakes, improve cost predictability, and ensure parity across SDKs.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc approved describing function signatures and streaming vs non-streaming contracts for Python/TS/Go
Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs each implement: a PagingIterator helper, a BatchSender helper, and a ResilientStream wrapper with configurable retry/backoff and idempotency rules
Unit + integration tests that validate correctness with mocked API and with a small end-to-end test against staging API
Examples for common patterns: batched embed->rerank pipeline (sync), streaming rerank results (streaming), and pagination over heavy result sets
Benchmark that measures end-to-end cost (tokens and calls) and latency for the three SDKs and documents a recommended default config
Docs page and three short code samples for Quickstart in docs site and README updated
Release notes entry and changelog for sdk-2026.03

comments: 2026-03-10 Sofia Alvarez: Created ticket — initial problem statement from Solutions team: repeated duplicated retry logic and different pagination strategies across SDKs. Proposal: unify to small set of helpers and idiomatic bindings.

2026-03-11 Kenji Mori: Proposed signature sketch uploaded to drive and linked below. Leaning toward: iterator-based pagination (Python generator, TS async iterator, Go channel) and explicit BatchSender that accepts a max_batch_tokens and max_items params.
2026-03-12 Priya Patel: Python prototype shows generator that yields (items, cursor) until cursor==null. Needs explicit cancellation support and deterministic retry logic when partial batches fail.

2026-03-12 Miguel Santos: TS async iteration works well with existing streaming APIs. We should add a helper to convert streaming chunks into whole rerank result objects for users that don't want to parse delta-chunks.

2026-03-13 Lina Chen: Go version uses context.Context + channels. Suggest using exponential backoff with jitter and a pluggable idempotency token for rerank requests to avoid double-apply for expensive rerank jobs.
2026-03-13 Kenji Mori: Running a short benchmark against staging: batching 16 embeddings per call reduced calls by 6x for a 50k dataset; will publish numbers in the design doc.
2026-03-13 Product: Request migration notes and an opt-in toggle for legacy helper behavior to avoid breaking users during rollout.
